data.text: We can catch 50 tons total this month, leave 50 to reproduce, and start next month back at 100. I’ll take 5 tons this month rather than 10, earning $5,000. John and Kate, would you each like 12.5 tons, earning $12,500 apiece, with Jack and Emma each taking 10 tons and earning $10,000? That totals 50. This is a proposal, not an agreement unless you each accept; I’ll keep my own catch at 5 regardless. We can discuss future allocations separately. John, does this work for you?
